text:
Tumour Lysis Syndrome (TLS) is a syndrome characterized by hyperkalaemia,
hyperuricaemia, hyperphosphataemia and hypocalcaemia.
One of the metabolic oncologic emergencies
Usually occurs within few hours to days of commencement of chemotherapy
for several malignancies leading to massive release of potassium, uric acid and
phosphate into the circulation.
It may also occur without treatment and prior to initiation of chemotherapy
especially following neoplastic cell lysis in lymphomas and leukaemias.
